description: Defines the interface for the PictureBufferManager class, which manages picture buffers and video frames in GPU-accelerated media processing within Chromium.

classes.name: PictureBufferManager
classes.description: Interface for managing picture buffers and video frames in GPU-accelerated media processing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a scoped_refptr of PictureBufferManager with specified GPU memory buffer allocation and reuse callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the manager with GPU task runner and command buffer helper; must be called before creating picture buffers.

methods.name: CanReadWithoutStalling
methods.description: Predicts if the Video Decode Accelerator can output a picture without reusing one first.

methods.name: CreatePictureBuffers
methods.description: Creates a specified number of picture buffers with given format, size, and texture parameters.

methods.name: DismissPictureBuffer
methods.description: Removes a picture buffer from the pool by ID.

methods.name: DismissAllPictureBuffers
methods.description: Removes all picture buffers from the pool.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame bound to a picture buffer with specified timestamp and size.
